title: LLM performance
description: LiteLLM time to first token, generation speed, latency, tokens and errors per model and upstream; x402-buyer paid upstreams.

options.content: Per-model, per-upstream (`api_base`) performance of the LiteLLM gateway. **TTFT** is time to the first streamed token; **decode tok/s** is generation speed after it. To compare models fairly, send the same prompt with `stream: true` through LiteLLM (`flows/llm-bench.sh`), set the time range to the run, and read the scoreboard: compare p50 TTFT of warm requests; the first request after a model loads is the cold-start cost. Recording rules `obol:llm_*` hold 5m one-number answers. Details: `docs/observability.md` → *LLM performance*.

panels.title: Models
panels.description: One row per model and upstream over the dashboard's time range. TTFT and latency quantiles come from histogram buckets; decode tok/s and e2e tok/s are window totals (see the throughput panels). *ok requests* counts successful upstream calls; *error ratio* is failed / all upstream calls for that deployment.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model, api_base) (increase(litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric_bucket{model=~"$model"}[$__range]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model, api_base) (increase(litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric_bucket{model=~"$model"}[$__range]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})))

sum by (model, api_base) (increase(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{model=~"$model"}[$__range]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})) / (sum by (model, api_base) ((increase(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_sum{model=~"$model"}[$__range]) - (increase(litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric_sum{model=~"$model"}[$__range]) or increase(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_sum{model=~"$model"}[$__range]) * 0)) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})) > 0)

sum by (model, api_base) (increase(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{model=~"$model"}[$__range]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})) / (sum by (model, api_base) (increase(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_sum{model=~"$model"}[$__range]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model, api_base) (increase(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_bucket{model=~"$model"}[$__range]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})))

sum by (model, api_base) (increase(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_count{model=~"$model"}[$__range]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"}))

sum by (model, api_base) (label_replace((sum by (litellm_model_name, api_base) (increase(litellm_deployment_failure_responses_total{litellm_model_name=~"$model", api_base=~"$api_base"}[$__range])) or sum by (litellm_model_name, api_base) (increase(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{litellm_model_name=~"$model", api_base=~"$api_base"}[$__range])) * 0) / clamp_min(sum by (litellm_model_name, api_base) (increase(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{litellm_model_name=~"$model", api_base=~"$api_base"}[$__range])), 1e-9), "model", "$1", "litellm_model_name", "(.*)"))

panels.title: TTFT p50
panels.description: Time to first token: LiteLLM's upstream call start → first streamed chunk (`litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric`). Recorded for **streaming requests only**. Includes network, queueing and prefill at the upstream; excludes LiteLLM's own pre-call overhead. Quantiles are interpolated from histogram buckets (0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7.5, 10 s, …).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model, api_base) (rate(litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric_bucket{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})))

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description: Time to first token: LiteLLM's upstream call start → first streamed chunk (`litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric`). Recorded for **streaming requests only**. Includes network, queueing and prefill at the upstream; excludes LiteLLM's own pre-call overhead. Quantiles are interpolated from histogram buckets (0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7.5, 10 s, …).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model, api_base) (rate(litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric_bucket{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})))

panels.title: TTFT p99
panels.description: Time to first token: LiteLLM's upstream call start → first streamed chunk (`litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric`). Recorded for **streaming requests only**. Includes network, queueing and prefill at the upstream; excludes LiteLLM's own pre-call overhead. Quantiles are interpolated from histogram buckets (0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7.5, 10 s, …).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, model, api_base) (rate(litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric_bucket{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})))

panels.title: Decode speed (output tok/s)
panels.description: Output tokens per second of decode time, aggregated over the window: `rate(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total) / (rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_sum) - rate(litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric_sum))`. Token-weighted mean, not a per-request median. Exact for streaming traffic; non-streaming requests have no TTFT, so their prefill counts as decode time and pulls the number down. Token counts are what the upstream reports in `usage` (LiteLLM estimates them when a stream carries no usage).

targets.expr: sum by (model, api_base) (rate(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})) / (sum by (model, api_base) ((rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_sum{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) - (rate(litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric_sum{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) or rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_sum{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * 0)) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})) > 0)

panels.title: End-to-end output tok/s
panels.description: Output tokens per second of total upstream time (prefill included): `rate(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total) / rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_sum)`. What a caller experiences for a whole response; short answers are dominated by TTFT.

targets.expr: sum by (model, api_base) (rate(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})) / (sum by (model, api_base) (rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_sum{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})) > 0)

panels.title: Tokens in / out per second
panels.description: Prompt (`litellm_input_tokens_metric_total`) and completion (`litellm_output_tokens_metric_total`) tokens per second, successful requests only.

targets.expr: sum by (model, api_base) (rate(litellm_input_tokens_metric_total{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"}))

sum by (model, api_base) (rate(litellm_output_tokens_metric_total{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"}))

panels.title: Upstream latency p50 / p95
panels.description: Whole upstream call, request sent → last byte (`litellm_llm_api_latency_metric`), successful requests. Scales with output length, so compare it only across identical prompts.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, model, api_base) (rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_bucket{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model, api_base) (rate(litellm_llm_api_latency_metric_bucket{model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval]) * on (model_id) group_left (api_base) group by (model_id, api_base) (litellm_deployment_state{api_base=~"$api_base"})))

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: All upstream calls per deployment (`litellm_deployment_total_requests_total`), successful or not.

targets.expr: sum by (litellm_model_name, api_base) (rate(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{litellm_model_name=~"$model", api_base=~"$api_base"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Failed / all upstream calls per deployment. Requests LiteLLM rejects before choosing a deployment (unknown model) appear with an empty model and api_base.

targets.expr: (sum by (litellm_model_name, api_base) (rate(litellm_deployment_failure_responses_total{litellm_model_name=~"$model", api_base=~"$api_base"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (litellm_model_name, api_base) (rate(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{litellm_model_name=~"$model", api_base=~"$api_base"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / clamp_min(sum by (litellm_model_name, api_base) (rate(litellm_deployment_total_requests_total{litellm_model_name=~"$model", api_base=~"$api_base"}[$__rate_interval])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Failures by status
panels.description: `litellm_deployment_failure_responses_total` by HTTP status and exception class.

targets.expr: sum by (litellm_model_name, api_base, exception_status, exception_class) (rate(litellm_deployment_failure_responses_total{litellm_model_name=~"$model", api_base=~"$api_base"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Gateway failures by requested model
panels.description: Every request that returned an error to the client (`litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total`), by the model name the client asked for. Not filtered by the variables: it has no upstream label.

targets.expr: sum by (requested_model, exception_status, exception_class) (rate(litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Deployments
panels.description: Deployments that have served traffic since LiteLLM started, with LiteLLM's health state (0 healthy, 1 partial outage, 2 complete outage).

targets.expr: max by (litellm_model_name, api_base, api_provider) (litellm_deployment_state{litellm_model_name=~"$model", api_base=~"$api_base"})

panels.title: Paid requests per second
panels.description: Requests the x402-buyer forwarded to purchased sellers. In LiteLLM these are `paid/*` models whose api_base is the x402-buyer Service, so the seller is only visible here.

targets.expr: sum by (upstream, remote_model) (rate(obol_x402_buyer_requests_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Payments
panels.description: x402 payments made by the buyer, successful and failed.

targets.expr: sum by (upstream) (rate(obol_x402_buyer_payment_success_total[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (upstream) (rate(obol_x402_buyer_payment_failure_total[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Pre-signed authorizations
panels.description: Remaining and spent pre-signed payment authorizations per purchased model (buyer's live view).

targets.expr: max by (upstream, remote_model, chain) (obol_x402_buyer_auth_remaining)
max by (upstream, remote_model, chain) (obol_x402_buyer_auth_spent)
